Start without a key

Install from the App Store, allow the microphone and speech recognition, then tap Start. On-device dictation stays free and does not count toward the trial. Add your own key in Settings later if you want cloud transcription or AI replies, then save and test.

How do I record, transcribe and replay on iPhone or iPad?

Record on iPhone, pause and resume, then transcribe with Apple speech recognition. Read a compact transcript preview or open the full text. Edit saved text and titles. With Pro, search titles and transcripts, and jump to marked moments or transcript timestamps. Use your chosen AI service for full-recording summaries, takeaways and action items. Open cited source text to check the result.

User-started iPhone and Watch audio recordings can continue in the background or with the screen locked. Stop and save to finish. Live dictation stops when you leave its screen.

With Pro, export original text, summaries, audio or a backup. Restoring an existing backup is free and merges records, skipping matching IDs and records marked deleted. Backups contain note content and available audio. API keys, purchase credentials and system settings are excluded.

Why has my Watch recording not reached iPhone?

Activate Pro on the paired iPhone and allow the Watch microphone. Check that Watch and iPhone are paired and connected, then open the iPhone app. Keep the original Watch recording while transfer is pending and use Retry if a transfer error appears. The received status appears after iPhone safely stores the recording. Receipt confirmation keeps the Watch original available.

Watch recordings and paired transfer

How do daily reviews and selected passages use my notes?

Search results take you to the matching text. Replay nearby audio when timing data is available. Select notes by date for a daily review of highlights, decisions and action items. Preview the exact text and recipient before generation. Gather manually marked moments and add titles or local notes. Select passages, adjust the text to send, then request a summary, action items, reply draft or communication review. Open linked sources to check the result. Verify AI interpretations yourself.

Selected text and AI source links

On-device dictation shows no text

Allow the microphone first. On-device dictation also needs speech recognition permission. Turn both on in system Settings, then tap Start again. Some languages may use Apple speech recognition if an offline model is missing, and that path needs a network.

How to connect your own API

On Mac, open Settings, choose an AI or transcription provider, enter the required credentials and select Save configuration. Then select Test connection and follow any prompt to authorize the recipient. A loopback AI model running on this Mac does not need cloud sending consent. AI tests send a fixed connectivity prompt; cloud transcription tests send one second of synthetic silence. They do not use private notes or microphone audio, but provider charges may apply. iPhone has its own provider setup controls. Free Apple Speech dictation needs no transcription key.

How trial and unlock work

Try all available Pro features. After the trial, search, precise playback, new AI actions, sharing and backups require purchase. Basic recording, viewing and editing saved content, normal playback and backup restoration remain free.

The trial runs for 168 consecutive hours from a successful claim. Reinstalling or restoring purchases keeps the original start time.

Already purchased? Restore with the same Apple Account. No second purchase is needed.

Eligible existing users keep their earlier free-feature rights and remaining API trial uses. The 7-day Pro trial does not consume those remaining uses.

Mac retains 20 shared trial uses for cloud transcription, AI and translation, followed by a one-time unlock.

One-time App Store purchase. See your storefront for the price.

AI and cloud transcription require your own API. Provider fees are separate. The app supplies no keys or credits.

I paid but it is still locked

Tap Restore Purchases in Settings and confirm you are using the Apple ID that paid. Sandbox and production purchases do not mix. With Family Sharing on, members of the same family can use this unlock.

Recording behavior on iPhone and Mac

User-started iPhone and Watch audio recordings can continue in the background or with the screen locked. Stop and save to finish. Live dictation stops when you leave its screen. On Mac, start and stop from the window, menu bar or Option-Shift-D. Command-Shift-P pauses or resumes. Quitting stops capture. Obtain any required recording consent.

I bought on iPhone. How do I open it on Mac?

On Mac, sign in with the same Apple ID, open the app, and tap Restore Purchases in Settings. This is a non-consumable unlock, not a second charge per device.

How do I capture meeting audio on Mac?

In Mac Settings, select system audio or mixed input. Allow screen and system audio recording in macOS Privacy & Security, then restart the app if macOS asks. Mixed input also needs microphone permission. The app uses ScreenCaptureKit for audio and does not save screen video. Use capture only with any required participant consent.

Mac microphone and system audio

How do I replay or export a recording?

Open a saved Mac session and select its recording. Playback includes a draggable playhead, 15-second skips and 0.75, 1, 1.25, 1.5 or 2× speed. Export transcript text, Markdown, meeting notes, individual audio or a session folder with its saved audio. Command-Shift-E exports Markdown. Missing audio prevents a complete session export; a transcript cannot recreate audio that was never saved.

How do I delete a Mac recording and undo it?

Stop listening, then use the recording trash button. The audio moves to the Mac Trash; text and notes remain. Command-Option-Z restores that single recording deletion during the same app run. Deleting a session or clearing history has no equivalent full-note undo. Bulk cleanup is irreversible; migrated originals, exports and backup copies must be managed separately.

How do I stop sending data to a provider?

In Mac Settings, open Account and Privacy, then revoke data sharing permission. The app cancels ongoing cloud and AI requests. Changing the recipient requires new permission. Data already received by Apple or a provider is governed by that service; contact it to request deletion.

Controls you already have

Can I import records from the older Mac app?

In Mac Settings, choose Import legacy records and select the old data folder. Keep a backup before importing. Text and available recordings are imported; a missing original audio file cannot be recovered from a transcript. Use Show data in Finder to locate the current app's data rather than assuming an old folder path.

Can I use an AI model running on my Mac?

Run a compatible chat completions service and set its endpoint in AI Settings, for example a loopback address on this Mac. Text sent to a model genuinely running on this Mac stays local to that service; a LAN or remote endpoint sends it off this Mac. Apple speech processing is independent. Local models still use the app's AI trial and unlock rules.

How do I pause and resume on Mac?

On Mac 1.2.2, select Pause or press Command-Shift-P. The current segment finishes and recording time stops. Resume adds a new audio segment to the same note. Wait for final processing before continuing, or cancel the wait to keep text already received and audio already written; the final sentence may be incomplete. Save recordings must be enabled to retain audio.

What should I do if saving fails?

Keep the Mac window open and preserve the unsaved text. Check free disk space, folder permissions and any external drive connection, then select Retry save or press Command-S. A failed save before switching notes keeps you on the current note. Do not clear history to troubleshoot. Unreturned recognition results and audio that was never saved cannot be recovered by retrying.

How do I find a phrase in this transcript?

On Mac, press Command-Option-F to find text within the current transcript. Command-F searches across saved sessions. You can edit transcript lines, then press Command-S to save. Search and local editing do not require an AI provider.

How do I move or back up my Mac library?

Stop listening and finish exports before choosing a storage folder in Settings. The app copies and verifies the library into Dictation Notes Data under the selected location, then switches to it; the original library stays in place. Reconnect an unavailable external drive. Use Show data in Finder to locate the active library. For a backup, stop and save, quit normally, then copy the entire library. A session-with-audio export covers that session only. Keep exported files and original libraries separately; the app does not sync them to iPhone.

Library copies, recovery and deletion

Where are the four Mac AI shortcuts?

The assistant keeps four actions above the input: suggest a reply, explain a concept, extract key takeaways and organize action items. Add your goal or background as needed. Configure and authorize an AI provider first; a compatible model running on this Mac is also supported. AI uses share the 20-use trial and one-time unlock; provider fees are separate. Review generated results before relying on them.
